name: toast
title: Toast
description: Transient notification. useToast().toast({ title, description, variant }).

meta.behaviourReason: Queue, timed dismissal, and announcements come from @ui-sdk/react/toast via createToaster. ToastViewport is a compatibility no-op; ToastProvider places ToastRegion.
meta.a11y: Errors are announced assertively. Do not steal focus.
